description: Annotation-driven Java library for generating Markdown documents from POJOs. Define your document structure as a plain Java class, annotate fields with @Heading, @Paragraph, @BlockQuote, @OrderedList, @UnorderedList or @Section, and call writeValueAsString() — similar to how Jackson generates JSON. Useful for generating structured LLM prompts from Java objects. See https://github.com/jaroslawdabrowski/pojo2md
